fix(release): Resolve publishable packages via pnpm workspace

The release scripts discovered packages by recursively walking the entire repo tree and selecting any non-private package.json. This swept in manifests outside the pnpm-workspace.yaml globs (fixtures, vendored copies), which could stage the wrong package under a legacy name.

Use 'pnpm list --recursive --depth -1 --json' as the source of truth so only real workspace members are considered for staging and publishing.
